title: Elf Bar ElfX Mini Pod Vape Kit
description: The Elf Bar Elfx Mini Pod Vape Kit delivers outstanding performance and ease of use in a stylish, compact format, making it an ideal choice for vapers seeking versatility and simplicity in a single lightweight device. With a built-in 1000mAh battery and a variable output range of 10–30W, the Elfx Mini starter kit supports both mouth-to-lung (MTL) and restricted direct-to-lung (RDTL) vaping styles with ease. Smart Mode ensures a seamless experience by detecting the resistance of your pod and setting the appropriate wattage automatically. Paired with the adjustable airflow slider, you can fine-tune your draw to be tighter or more open depending on your preference. The integrated RGB light ring provides clear, colour-coded battery level indicators at a glance. The Elfx Mini is compatible with the full range of Elfx pods, which feature dual QUAQ mesh coil technology for clean flavour and smooth, satisfying vapour. This kit includes a refillable 2ml 0.6ohm Elfx Pod, ideal for 50/50 e-liquids and Nic Salt blends. Top-filling means you can refill without removing the pod, and when the coil wears out, simply replace the entire pod — no messy coil changes required. With its fast Type-C charging, responsive inhale activation, and pocket-friendly size, the Elfx Mini is a strong everyday option for vapers seeking performance and flexibility without the complexity of more advanced vape kits. The Elf Bar ElfX Mini is compatible with a wide range of vape juices . Please Note: When filling your pod with e-liquid for the first time, allow the pod to sit for ten minutes before use. This will allow the e-liquid to better saturate the wicking material, a type of cotton, to prevent dry hits and ensure the best flavour and performance from your coil. Please Note: This kit does not come with a USB-C charging cable.
